About Dhow Coast Travels

Licensed Zanzibar tour operator. WhatsApp-first booking. Transparent pricing with marine fees included. Based in Mbuzini, Magharibi District, Zanzibar.

Our Story

Built by Locals, for Travellers

Dhow Coast Travels was founded by locals who grew up on these islands. We know every beach, every spice farm, every dhow captain, and every guide by name. We built this company because we saw too many visitors overpay for generic tours, miss the authentic experiences, and leave without truly understanding Zanzibar.

Why Us

What Makes Us Different

Six commitments that define every booking with Dhow Coast Travels.

💰

Transparent Pricing

Marine park fees, guide fees, and transfers are included in our quotes — no surprise costs at the dock.

💬

WhatsApp-First Booking

No forms, no waiting for email replies. Message us on WhatsApp and get a quote within minutes.

📋

Licensed & Insured

Registered with the Zanzibar Commission for Tourism (ZCT). All guides and boat operators are licensed.

🏝️

Local Knowledge

We only work with suppliers we know personally — dhow captains, spice farm owners, village hosts.

🐬

Ethical Operations

No dolphin chasing, no turtle riding, no staged cultural performances. Responsible tourism by default.

⚖️

Fair Pricing

We publish price ranges upfront. You'll always know the supplier net rate vs. our commission.

Commitments

Our Commitments

  • 🌊
    Marine Conservation: Every Safari Blue booking includes the $10 Menai Bay conservation fee. Every Mnemba booking includes the $25 marine park fee.
  • 🤝
    Community Benefit: Village tours include direct donations to community development funds.
  • 👨‍💼
    Guide Welfare: We ensure fair pay and working conditions for all guides and boat crew.
  • 🛡️
    Safety First: All boats carry life jackets, VHF radio, and first aid. Captains are certified.
Compliance

Licensing & Compliance

Dhow Coast Travels operates under Zanzibar Tourism Act No. 6 of 2009 and ZCT licensing requirements. Tour operations are reserved for Zanzibari-owned companies — we are 100% locally owned.

License: ZCT Tour Operator License (application in progress)
Insurance: Public liability coverage
Banking: CRDB Bank, Stone Town branch
